scripts.build: npm run build -w @pointback/protocol && npm run build -w @pointback/browser && npm run build -w @pointback/daemon && npm run build -w @pointback/vite && npm run build -w @pointback/mcp && npm run build -w @pointback/cli && npm run build -w @pointback/pi && npm run build -w @pointback/example-vanilla && npm run build -w @pointback/example-react
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @pointback/protocol && npm run build -w @pointback/daemon && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @pointback/protocol && npm run build -w @pointback/daemon && npm run build -w @pointback/pi && npm run build -w @pointback/mcp && npm run build -w @pointback/browser && npm run build -w @pointback/vite && npm run build -w @pointback/example-react && node --experimental-strip-types --test packages/protocol/src/*.test.ts packages/daemon/src/*.test.ts packages/mcp/src/*.test.ts packages/adapters/pi/src/*.test.ts examples/vanilla-vite/smoke.test.ts examples/react-vite/source.test.ts
